name: Atori no Sora to Shinchuu no Tsuki
original_name: アトリの空と真鍮の月
source:
There is a school in a small village. One day, Haito, who is back to the village for the first time in six years, transfers to this school, but there are only four female students. According to them, people in the village believe in some kind of god. As he lives there, he gradually finds a secret the villagers try to hide...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一座小村庄里有一所学校。一天，阔别六年回到村庄的海人转入这所学校，却发现校内只有四名女学生。据她们所说，村民信奉着某种神明。随着海人在此生活，他逐渐发现了村民竭力隐藏的秘密…

[摘自ErogeShop]
